high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "Deadpool & Wolverine," produced by Marvel Studios. The poster features a close-up of two characters: Deadpool and Wolverine. Characters: Deadpool: Positioned at the top of the image, wearing his iconic red and black suit with a mask that covers most of his face, leaving only his eyes visible. Wolverine: Below Deadpool, wearing his signature black suit with a red collar and gold accents on the shoulders. His face is partially obscured by two crossed swords, which are a prominent feature of the image. Objects:
